title: LoM Texture Pack
description:
A texture pack made for the many misadventures of the League of Mothers and friends.
Made by PoppyChannel
body:
A resoruce pack made for the League of Mothers and friends featuring many of the iconic faces from the LoM.
The pack has unique new custom models made that replace most of the mobs with characters from the LoM along with custom voicelines recorded or plucked from online. Each of the custom mob models also come with a wide range of alternate skins that are randomly applied to the mob, or can be chosen via a nametag.

Various items and tools have been re-textured or even given a custom 3D model to be ascoiated with the LoM. Some of these require the item to be renamed at an anvil first. The paintings have all been given a new coat of paint and transformed into beautiful LoM artwork.

Many other inclusions such as the music discs and menu music have also been switched out for iconic LoM tunes from over the years. The main menu has a custom LoM theme to it that showcases various features of the pack, such as the mobs.
